label: Domatowo
description: AI agent searches ruined city for a wounded partisan: deploys scouts via transporters, inspects tall buildings, and calls a rescue helicopter when found — all within a 300-point budget.

steps.label: Map Reconnaissance
steps.detail: Fetch help docs and the 11×11 city map; AI identifies the tallest building clusters

steps.label: Deploy Units
steps.detail: AI plans and creates transporters with scouts, balancing creation costs against the 300-pt budget

steps.label: Search & Inspect
steps.detail: Transporters move along streets; scouts dismount and inspect tall-building fields for the partisan

steps.label: Call Helicopter
steps.detail: Once a scout finds the partisan, agent calls the rescue helicopter to that location
